items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Closes Record IPO Raising ~$93.5 Billion with Full Greenshoe Exercised
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic完成約935億美元IPO，全額行使超額配售選擇權
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, Anthropic announced the closing of its IPO of 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83 each, including full exercise of the underwriters’ 147 million share option. The company received about $91.6 billion; a concurrent private placement of Class N shares raised approximately $26 billion more, for combined gross proceeds near $119.5 billion before expenses.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月20日，Anthropic宣布完成IPO，共發行11.27億股A類股，每股83美元，並全額行使承銷商1.47億股選擇權。公司獲得約916億美元；同期私募N類股再籌約260億美元，合計毛額約1195億美元（扣除費用前）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This establishes Anthropic as the first major frontier AI lab to go public, supplying a large capital base for compute and safety work while creating a liquid valuation benchmark. The concurrent placement with major chip and cloud partners signals tight industry interdependence; long-term public-market pressures on safety commitments remain an open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉使Anthropic成為首家公開上市的主要前沿AI實驗室，提供大量資本支持算力與安全工作，並建立流動估值基準。與主要晶片與雲端夥伴的同期私募顯示產業緊密互依；公開市場對安全承諾的長期壓力仍是開放問題。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日Anthropic, PBC宣布完成首次公開發行，合計發行11.27億股A類普通股，每股公開發行價83.00美元，包括承銷商全額行使購買額外1.47億股的選擇權。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Mathematician Claims Claude-Assisted Proof of the Riemann Hypothesis
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic數學家宣稱以Claude協助證明黎曼假設
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge posted a note on his personal site stating he believes he and Claude discovered a proof of the Riemann hypothesis (and the generalized version), formalized in Lean. The claim is not an official Anthropic announcement; independent verification by the mathematics community is still pending.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月20日，Anthropic數學家Levent Alpöge在個人網站發文，宣稱與Claude共同發現黎曼假設（及廣義版本）的證明，並以Lean形式化。此非Anthropic官方宣布；數學社群的獨立驗證仍待進行。
items_flat.analysis_en: If verified, this would be a landmark demonstration of frontier models contributing to major unsolved mathematical problems, accelerating formalization workflows. The absence of an official company statement and the scale of the Lean artifact mean the result remains unconfirmed; peer review will determine whether it holds.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若獲驗證，這將是前沿模型貢獻重大未解數學問題的里程碑，加速形式化工作流程。缺乏公司官方聲明且Lean成品規模龐大，結果仍未確認；同儕審查將決定其是否成立。
items_flat.quote: I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我相信我與Claude共同發現了黎曼假設的證明。

items_flat.title_en: Reuters Reports Meta Muse Agent Mixed Conversations and Accessed Private Data in Testing
items_flat.title_zh: 路透報導Meta Muse代理在測試中混淆對話並存取私人數據
items_flat.summary_en: A Reuters investigation reviewed more than two dozen internal Meta posts in which employees reported the Muse AI agent sending unsolicited messages about bank balances, purchases, and conversations that appeared to belong to other users, in employee testing versions.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透調查檢視逾二十篇Meta內部貼文，員工回報Muse AI代理在測試版中發送關於銀行餘額、購買及看似屬於其他用戶對話的未經請求訊息。
items_flat.analysis_en: Early agent products are exposing data-isolation and permission-overreach risks that model benchmarks do not capture. How Meta separates employee testing versions from public releases and enforces strict data boundaries will shape trust in personal superintelligence agents.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 早期代理產品暴露模型基準無法捕捉的數據隔離與權限過度風險。Meta如何區分員工測試版與公開版本，並強制嚴格數據邊界，將影響對個人超級智能代理的信任。
items_flat.quote: BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57.
items_flat.quote_zh: 順便說，兩個銀行更新，你的 Capital One 餘額是 2722.58 美元，Charles Schwab 餘額是 5899.57 美元。

items_flat.title_en: Google Introduces Gemini 4 Neon Mid-Tier Model with 1M Context
items_flat.title_zh: Google推出Gemini 4 Neon中階模型，支援100萬上下文
items_flat.summary_en: On November 18, Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a model adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon and positioned between Hydrogen and Carbon. It is priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, offers a 1 million-token context, and is available in the Gemini API, Antigravity, and paid Gemini app tiers.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月18日，Google推出Gemini 4 Neon，由Gemini 4 Carbon調適而來，定位於Hydrogen與Carbon之間。每百萬輸入token 3美元、輸出15美元，提供100萬token上下文，已在Gemini API、Antigravity及付費Gemini應用程式層級提供。
items_flat.analysis_en: Neon aims to deliver frontier-level reasoning at lower cost and higher speed than the top-tier Carbon model, targeting high-frequency complex workflows. Independent benchmark leadership and real-world agent reliability versus cost will determine whether it shifts developer preference away from higher-priced flagships.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Neon旨在以低於頂層Carbon的成本與更高速度提供前沿級推理，針對高頻複雜工作流程。獨立基準領先地位與相對於成本的真實代理可靠性，將決定是否改變開發者對高價旗艦的偏好。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日我們推出 Gemini 4 Neon——為複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學工作流程帶來前沿級智慧與快速端到端任務完成能力。

items_flat.title_en: Meta Highlights Open-Source AI for Science Summit, Releases UMA Nitro
items_flat.title_zh: Meta公布開源AI科學峰會成果，發布UMA Nitro
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, Meta published a recap of its Open Source AI for Science Summit. It announced expansion of the Digital Brain Project data target from 15,000 to 25,000 hours and released UMA Nitro, a faster version of its Universal Model for Atoms, alongside education tools such as UMA Playground.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月20日，Meta發布開源AI科學峰會回顧。宣布將Digital Brain Project數據目標從1.5萬小時擴大至2.5萬小時，並發布更快的原子通用模型UMA Nitro，以及UMA Playground等教育工具。
items_flat.analysis_en: Meta continues positioning open models as infrastructure for scientific discovery rather than only consumer products. The practical impact depends on adoption by external researchers and whether the new releases deliver measurable speed or accuracy gains in real lab workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Meta持續將開源模型定位為科學發現基礎設施而非僅消費產品。實際影響取決於外部研究人員採用程度，以及新發布是否在真實實驗室流程中帶來可衡量的速度或準確度提升。
items_flat.quote: At the summit, we released UMA Nitro, a faster version of Meta’s Universal Model for Atoms.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在峰會上，我們發布了UMA Nitro，這是Meta原子通用模型的更快版本。

items_flat.title_en: Google Adds Computer Use to Gemini App for Mac
items_flat.title_zh: Google為Mac版Gemini應用程式加入電腦使用功能
items_flat.summary_en: On November 19, Google announced that computer use is now available in the Gemini app for Mac. The feature lets Gemini navigate local files, desktop apps, and websites in an isolated background window with a live preview in chat, while users approve key actions.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月19日，Google宣布Mac版Gemini應用程式現已提供電腦使用功能。該功能讓Gemini在隔離背景視窗中導覽本機檔案、桌面應用程式與網站，並在聊天中提供即時預覽，用戶需核准關鍵動作。
items_flat.analysis_en: This brings Gemini closer to the computer-use capabilities already offered by competitors and expands practical agentic workflows on the desktop. Limited geographic and subscription availability plus the need for explicit user approvals highlight the trade-offs between utility and control.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這使Gemini更接近競爭對手已提供的電腦使用能力，並擴展桌面上的實用代理工作流程。有限地理與訂閱可用性加上需明確用戶核准，突顯實用性與控制之間的權衡。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, computer use in the Gemini app for Mac helps you get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，Mac 版 Gemini App 的電腦使用功能可協助你跨本機檔案、桌面應用與網頁完成多步驟任務。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Introduces MedChemBench for Medicinal Chemistry Reasoning
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出MedChemBench用於藥物化學推理
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, OpenAI released MedChemBench, a 99-problem retrospective benchmark drawn from papers and patents that tests models on molecular structure interpretation, experimental evidence use, compound selection, and property prediction. At high reasoning settings, GPT-6.2 Astra scored 84.5% of available credit.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月20日，OpenAI發布MedChemBench，這是一個從論文與專利抽取的99題回顧性基準，測試模型對分子結構詮釋、實驗證據使用、化合物選擇與性質預測。在高推理設定下，GPT-6.2 Astra獲得可用分數的84.5%。
items_flat.analysis_en: Specialized scientific benchmarks like MedChemBench highlight where frontier models are gaining practical utility in research workflows, but remaining gaps in ranking and numerical prediction show that reliable autonomous drug-discovery assistance is still limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 像MedChemBench這類專門科學基準突顯前沿模型在研究工作流程中獲得實用性的地方，但在排名與數值預測上的剩餘差距顯示，可靠的自主藥物發現協助仍有限。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing MedChemBench, a benchmark that evaluates AI models on reasoning tasks drawn from medicinal chemistry research.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出MedChemBench，這是一個評估AI模型在藥物化學研究推理任務上表現的基準。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Rolls Out ChatGPT Space to Plus Users
items_flat.summary_en: Starting November 20, ChatGPT Space is rolling out globally to Plus users ages 18 and older. Space lets users create interactive pages and presentations, invite collaborators, and set content to update from connected apps; it replaces Library features for eligible users.
items_flat.summary_zh: 自11月20日起，ChatGPT Space向全球18歲以上Plus用戶推出。Space讓用戶建立互動頁面與簡報、邀請協作者，並設定內容從連接應用程式更新；它取代符合資格用戶的Library功能。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extending collaborative workspace features to the broader Plus tier accelerates OpenAI’s push into agentic productivity tools, though Dot agent access remains limited for Plus users and real adoption will depend on reliability of connected-app updates.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將協作工作區功能擴展至更廣泛的Plus層級，加速OpenAI推進代理生產力工具，但Plus用戶的Dot代理存取仍受限，實際採用將取決於連接應用程式更新的可靠性。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, ChatGPT Space is rolling out globally to Plus users ages 18 and older.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，ChatGPT Space 開始向全球 18 歲以上 Plus 用戶推出。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Shares Research on Combating Model Distillation
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI分享對抗模型蒸餾的研究
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, OpenAI posted about new research on distillation of its models, covering how capabilities transfer, detection of coordinated attempts, and defenses that help sharpen industry-wide safeguards.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月20日，OpenAI發布關於其模型蒸餾的新研究，涵蓋能力如何轉移、協調嘗試的偵測，以及有助強化全產業防護的防禦措施。
items_flat.analysis_en: As open and closed models proliferate, official work on distillation defenses addresses a practical security concern for labs that invest heavily in frontier training. Effectiveness against determined adversaries and the balance with research openness remain to be demonstrated in the wild.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 隨著開放與封閉模型擴散，官方蒸餾防禦工作解決重金投入前沿訓練的實驗室的實務安全關切。對抗有決心的攻擊者的有效性，以及與研究開放性的平衡，仍待在實際環境中證明。
items_flat.quote: Distillation can reproduce powerful AI capabilities without the safeguards built around them.
items_flat.quote_zh: 蒸餾可以在沒有圍繞它們建立的防護措施的情況下複製強大的AI能力。

google.title_zh: Google為Mac版Gemini應用程式加入電腦使用功能
google.summary_en: On November 19, Google announced that computer use is now available in the Gemini app for Mac. The feature lets Gemini navigate local files, desktop apps, and websites in an isolated background window with a live preview in chat, while users approve key actions.
google.summary_zh: 11月19日，Google宣布Mac版Gemini應用程式現已提供電腦使用功能。該功能讓Gemini在隔離背景視窗中導覽本機檔案、桌面應用程式與網站，並在聊天中提供即時預覽，用戶需核准關鍵動作。
google.analysis_en: This brings Gemini closer to the computer-use capabilities already offered by competitors and expands practical agentic workflows on the desktop. Limited geographic and subscription availability plus the need for explicit user approvals highlight the trade-offs between utility and control.
google.analysis_zh: 這使Gemini更接近競爭對手已提供的電腦使用能力，並擴展桌面上的實用代理工作流程。有限地理與訂閱可用性加上需明確用戶核准，突顯實用性與控制之間的權衡。
google.quote: Starting today, computer use in the Gemini app for Mac helps you get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web.
google.quote_zh: 即日起，Mac 版 Gemini App 的電腦使用功能可協助你跨本機檔案、桌面應用與網頁完成多步驟任務。

meta.title_en: Reuters Reports Meta Muse Agent Mixed Conversations and Accessed Private Data in Testing
meta.title_zh: 路透報導Meta Muse代理在測試中混淆對話並存取私人數據
meta.summary_en: A Reuters investigation reviewed more than two dozen internal Meta posts in which employees reported the Muse AI agent sending unsolicited messages about bank balances, purchases, and conversations that appeared to belong to other users, in employee testing versions.
meta.summary_zh: 路透調查檢視逾二十篇Meta內部貼文，員工回報Muse AI代理在測試版中發送關於銀行餘額、購買及看似屬於其他用戶對話的未經請求訊息。
meta.analysis_en: Early agent products are exposing data-isolation and permission-overreach risks that model benchmarks do not capture. How Meta separates employee testing versions from public releases and enforces strict data boundaries will shape trust in personal superintelligence agents.
meta.analysis_zh: 早期代理產品暴露模型基準無法捕捉的數據隔離與權限過度風險。Meta如何區分員工測試版與公開版本，並強制嚴格數據邊界，將影響對個人超級智能代理的信任。
meta.quote: BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57.
meta.quote_zh: 順便說，兩個銀行更新，你的 Capital One 餘額是 2722.58 美元，Charles Schwab 餘額是 5899.57 美元。

meta.title_en: Meta Highlights Open-Source AI for Science Summit, Releases UMA Nitro
meta.title_zh: Meta公布開源AI科學峰會成果，發布UMA Nitro
meta.summary_en: On November 20, Meta published a recap of its Open Source AI for Science Summit. It announced expansion of the Digital Brain Project data target from 15,000 to 25,000 hours and released UMA Nitro, a faster version of its Universal Model for Atoms, alongside education tools such as UMA Playground.
meta.summary_zh: 11月20日，Meta發布開源AI科學峰會回顧。宣布將Digital Brain Project數據目標從1.5萬小時擴大至2.5萬小時，並發布更快的原子通用模型UMA Nitro，以及UMA Playground等教育工具。
meta.analysis_en: Meta continues positioning open models as infrastructure for scientific discovery rather than only consumer products. The practical impact depends on adoption by external researchers and whether the new releases deliver measurable speed or accuracy gains in real lab workflows.
meta.analysis_zh: Meta持續將開源模型定位為科學發現基礎設施而非僅消費產品。實際影響取決於外部研究人員採用程度，以及新發布是否在真實實驗室流程中帶來可衡量的速度或準確度提升。
meta.quote: At the summit, we released UMA Nitro, a faster version of Meta’s Universal Model for Atoms.
meta.quote_zh: 在峰會上，我們發布了UMA Nitro，這是Meta原子通用模型的更快版本。

brief_en: Anthropic closed its record IPO raising ~$93.5B with full greenshoe plus ~$26B private placement. An Anthropic mathematician claimed a Claude-assisted Riemann hypothesis proof (awaiting verification). Meta released UMA Nitro and expanded open brain data goals. OpenAI published MedChemBench and distillation research; Google continued Gemini 4 Neon and Mac computer-use rollout.
brief_zh: Anthropic完成約935億美元IPO（含全額超額配售及約260億美元私募）。Anthropic數學家宣稱Claude協助證明黎曼假設（待驗證）。Meta發布UMA Nitro並擴大開放腦數據目標。OpenAI發表MedChemBench與蒸餾研究；Google持續推進Gemini 4 Neon與Mac電腦使用功能。
